question: What role does Rudrāṇī play in the cyclical activity described here?
premises: Rudrāṇī, whose body is made of the guṇas beginning with sattva, acts by the deity's will.
She emits or brings forth in each cycle.
She is worshiped at the altar in each cycle.
inference: Rudrāṇī functions as a cyclical creative and ritual power under the deity's will.
uncertainties: The object of visṛjati is not explicitly stated in this verse.
plain_english: By his will, Rudrāṇī, whose body consists of the qualities beginning with sattva, brings forth in each cycle, and there she is worshiped at the altar in every cycle.
